name: Lawrence Preston Gise

summary.text: Lawrence Preston Gise was a career official of the U.S. Atomic Energy Commission who served as Deputy Manager of its Albuquerque Operations Office from May 1957 to January 1961 and was later appointed Manager of that office, which oversaw the nuclear-weapons laboratories and production complex. He is the maternal grandfather of Amazon founder Jeff Bezos. Accounts that he helped found or direct ARPA in 1958 rest on secondary sources and are disputed.

facts.claim: A secondary account states that Gise worked for the Atomic Energy Commission from 1949 and served in an administrative role at ARPA in the late 1950s focused on programme control, but that he was not a founder of ARPA, whose first director was Roy Johnson.

connections.claim: Gise was the maternal grandfather of Jeff Bezos.

openQuestions: The site's 'Gise-ARPA lineage' rests on Gise's ARPA role. No primary ARPA or DARPA record of his position was found; the AEC roles are documented in congressional and archival records, while the ARPA role appears only in blogs and is disputed as to its extent. Partly unsupported.
The family link is sourced here only to a Substack post; a mainstream biography of Bezos should be substituted.
